answers.message:
**DEMO-33 is stuck on a red build** after approval. **DEMO-31 and DEMO-30 look finished in code**, but their cards still sit in In progress.
Likely · GitHub + Jira: GitHub and Jira agree.

Does the team test after merge, in which case DEMO-31 and DEMO-30 are correctly in progress, or are they simply done?

Why:
- DEMO-33: Pull request acme/shop#203 was approved 1 day ago and its latest checks are failing, so the red build is what stands between it and the merge. (GitHub)
- DEMO-33: Jonas commented 1 day ago: approved, the e2e checkout test fails on CI but passes locally, flaky? Nobody has answered. (Jira)
- Ruled out: DEMO-33: Not waiting for reviewers: the first look came after 3 days and there are no requested changes. (GitHub)
- DEMO-31: Pull request acme/shop#204 merged 4 days ago, yet the card has been in In progress for 5 days with no comment on what remains. (GitHub)
- DEMO-30: Pull request acme/shop#205 was ready 7 days ago and merged 2 days ago. The card only moved to In progress 2 days ago, so the board lagged the work. (GitHub)

Options:
A. Settle the DEMO-33 build first: re-run the e2e check, or fix it if it fails again, then merge. Ana needs a short look at the test. A flaky test may keep coming back. Check: acme/shop#203 shows passing checks and is merged by the next refresh. (recommended)
B. Ask Tom and Ana whether DEMO-31 and DEMO-30 are done. Move them on if so, or name the remaining step. Costs a quick conversation. It makes any hidden wait visible, such as testing after the merge. Check: Both cards leave In progress or carry a comment within two days. (recommended)
C. Agree that a card moves when its pull request is ready or merged, not days later. Needs a team habit. It also hides nothing, but the board will be more accurate and the age numbers more reliable. Check: No new item shows a gap between merge and card move next week.
Recommended because A frees the oldest of the three, which is already past the usual limit, and B is a cheap check that may clear two cards.

58% of the time inside Review passes before anyone looks at the code. DEMO-34 has waited 5 days with no review yet.

answers.label: What is the failing build holding up?
answers.question:
An approved pull request is held by failing checks
DEMO-33: the checks on its latest commit fail. It is already approved, so only the checks stand between it and the merge.

Pull requests have failing checks on their latest commit. For each, say how long it has been open, whether it is already approved, and what the red build holds back on the board. Propose the smallest team agreement, such as fixing a red build before new work, with a measurable checkpoint. Never blame whoever wrote the code.
answers.message:
Only **DEMO-33** has a red build: its pull request acme/shop#203 is approved and open, and a failing end-to-end checkout test is the only thing holding the merge.
Likely · GitHub + Jira + Board: GitHub, Jira and the board agree.
Next step: Ask Ana whether the failing end-to-end checkout test can be re-run or fixed today, since Jonas's approval comment already suspects it is flaky. Check: acme/shop#203 shows passing checks and merged, and DEMO-33 leaves In progress, by the next refresh.
Has the checkout test failed on CI before for other pull requests, or only on acme/shop#203?

Why:
- DEMO-33: acme/shop#203 has been ready for review for 6 days and approved for 1 day, with no changes requested. The latest commit's checks are failing. (GitHub)
- DEMO-33: Jonas commented 1 day ago: 'Approved. The e2e checkout test fails on CI but passes locally. Flaky?' This points to an unstable test, though nobody has confirmed it. (Jira)
- DEMO-33: The card has sat in In progress for 11 days and is now late. It still counts as active work, and a bundle-discount bug fix is waiting on a merge it already has approval for. (Board)
- Ruled out: DEMO-34, DEMO-35, DEMO-90, DEMO-89: No other open pull request has failing checks. DEMO-34 and DEMO-89 pass, and DEMO-35 and DEMO-90 are still running. (GitHub)
- Ruled out: DEMO-33: Not waiting for reviewers: the first look came after 3 days, the approval is in, and the pull request is small at 140 lines. (GitHub)

Options:
A. Re-run the checkout test on acme/shop#203 and merge if it goes green. Cheap and quick, but it hides a flaky test if the re-run happens to pass. Check: acme/shop#203 merged and DEMO-33 moved on within 1 working day. (recommended)
B. Treat the checkout test as a bug of its own: quarantine or fix it, then merge. Takes longer for DEMO-33 but stops the same red build hitting later pull requests. Check: Checkout test passes on 5 consecutive builds by the next refresh.
C. Agree a team rule: a red build on an approved pull request is fixed or re-run before anyone starts new work. Slows new starts slightly. Active work has already grown from 4 to 9 items. Check: Zero approved pull requests with failing checks older than 1 working day at each weekly review. (recommended)
Recommended because A clears the single red build today, and C is the smallest agreement that stops approved work waiting on CI.
